skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

version.changelog: Refresh API Key guidance to the SocialDataX AI access page.

llm.summary: This skill is a read-only helper for fetching and analyzing Xiaohongshu comments through SocialDataX using the user's API key.

dimensions.detail: Use of SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network calls to SocialDataX is disclosed and proportionate to retrieving hosted social-media data; the artifact says it does not read browser data or perform login, posting, liking, commenting, or account changes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on Node/npm and runs the external npm package socialdatax-skills via npx at latest; this is disclosed in metadata and is typical for this integration, but users should understand that latest can change over time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-provided note URLs, complete note IDs, comment IDs, pagination options, and output guidance; they explicitly separate evidence from conclusions and warn not to invent feedback.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, local profile/session access, or mutation authority is requested by this skill; comment pagination can be broad when the user chooses --all or --include-replies.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Xiaohongshu comment analysis, pain-point extraction, FAQ generation, and feedback review; the runtime instructions fetch comments or replies and then summarize returned data, which fits that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable giving the SocialDataX CLI access to SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sending the provided Xiaohongshu note or comment identifiers to SocialDataX. Use --max-items or --pages instead of --all when you want to limit API usage or credit consumption.
llm.findings: [SkillSpector: none] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, and artifact inspection did not reveal hidden behavior, destructive actions, credential misuse beyond the disclosed SocialDataX API key, or purpose-mismatched authority.
